title: Investigate nested detached launchers classified as registered focused Tests
outcome: Determine whether a focused registered stage can earn an early passing Test from a nested or detached launcher exit, and document or repair the confirmed behavior separately.
acceptance: Bounded behavioral evidence confirms or rules out an early passing Test record for nested/detached launcher inner commands before the actual suite completes.
If confirmed, a separate reviewed repair preserves genuine completed Test outcomes and refuses launch-only evidence; otherwise the reason the path is unreachable is recorded.
